name: Invest for Kids Summer Investment Challenge
org: DePaul University, Driehaus College of Business
city: DePaul Lincoln Park and Loop campuses, Chicago, IL
what_you_do: Live on campus for five days and four nights in a team sponsored by a company. Learn markets and valuation, use Excel and Bloomberg tools, then pitch a stock idea to professionals.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in finance careers. No grade, school or location rule is listed on the page.
pay_detail: Free of charge (the page says so). No pay.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: The page does not describe the steps. Contact Professor Vahap Uysal at (312) 362-8826 or vuysal@depaul.edu.
notes: Free, but dates and how to apply are not on the page, so email first. A search summary said past students were picked from Chicago Public Schools; the official page itself lists no school rule.
